messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate for inference-service-us-west-2 (model=redwood-large-v1-quant) — 5xx spike to 18% in last 5m. P95 latency up from 600ms -> 2.4s. Error class: SIGSEGV / OOM / 502 gateway. Pager triggered to oncall.
carol_oncall: acked. I'm pulling logs and starting triage. Paging @alice_sre and @bob_runtime.
alice_sre: on it. seeing repeated worker crashes in runner logs: stack traces show segfault in attention kernel, and OOMs on jitted-kernel allocation. sample log:```[2026-03-15T18:10:05Z] runner[pid=1423]: Fatal signal 11 (SIGSEGV) at 0x7f8.../quant_attn_kernel.cu:243
[2026-03-15T18:10:06Z] runner[pid=1423]: Out of memory allocating 256MB for workspace (gpu=0)```
bob_runtime: quick hypothesis — quantized attention kernel regression after last runtime bump. rolling fallback plan: 1) route traffic to model-variant 'redwood-large-v1-quant-lite' 2) disable continuous batching on affected pool 3) scale up dedicated pool nodes while we investigate.
devex_jordan: customer-impact note: visible errors on prod routes /api/generate for some customers, estimated 3% of requests failed in last 10m. one enterprise tenant reported session disconnects. adding to status page draft.
pm_anu: please confirm customers affected and suggested message. we should put a brief note: "Degraded inference performance and elevated error rates for specific model in US-WEST. Working on mitigation."
customer-success-liz: customer "AcmeCorp" reported retries and latency spikes; engineering can reach out if needed. They asked if there's a workaround.
alice_sre: commands I'm running now:```# check crashing podskubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep runner```and```kubectl -n inference logs runner-abcde -c runner --since=10m | tail -n 200```Found core dumps on nodes: infra-node-12, infra-node-15. Collecting cores:```gdb --batch -ex "bt full" -ex "quit" /opt/runner/bin/runner /var/crash/core.runner.1423 > /tmp/core.bt.1423.txt```
carol_oncall: are we seeing new deploys? any canary?
alice_sre: last runtime deploy to us-west-2 was 23m ago (release-2026.03.15.1). I'm rolling a targeted rollback of the kernel module to previous build on affected pool. Also temporarily increasing model-runner memory limit from 8Gi -> 10Gi for nodes with margin:```kubectl -n inference patch deployment runner --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"runner","resources":{"limits":{"memory":"10Gi"}}}]}}}}'```
bob_runtime: I'm flipping routing rules now to route 50% of traffic away from affected nodes to fallbacks. command:```internalctl route modify --service inference --model redwood-large-v1-quant --region us-west-2 --split 50:50 --target redwood-large-v1-quant-lite```Expect to see 5xx drop within 2-5 min.
devex_jordan: updated status page draft and customer notifications. pinged AcmeCorp CSM.
alice_sre: mitigation progress: after rollback and memory bump, crashes reduced but not eliminated. still seeing periodic segfaults ~1 every 3m on node infra-node-15. pushing hotfix to disable optimized attention path for that kernel:```export RUNNER_FLAGS=\"--disable-quant-attn-optim\" systemctl restart runner```Applying to 4 pods on infra-node-15.
bob_runtime: monitoring metrics... 5xx now down to ~6% from 18%. P95 down to 900ms. Good partial mitigation. Keeping traffic split until stable.
carol_oncall: excellent. log summary for postmortem: initial regression appears correlated with runtime bump (release-2026.03.15.1) that enabled new quant attention kernel. impact window start 2026-03-15T18:09Z.
customer-success-liz: AcmeCorp confirmed degraded but accepts retry guidance for now. asking for ETA for full restore.
pm_anu: please add ETA note: aiming for full restore in 60m, will update in 15m.
alice_sre: collecting heal metrics and core dumps for root cause. saving core dumps to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/7112223334/. tags: model=redwood-large-v1-quant, kernel=quant-attn-v2.
bob_runtime: next steps — plan a rollback of release-2026.03.15.1 across us-west-2 if we see reoccurrence after disabling optim path. schedule a canary test in staging with stress workload.
carol_oncall: oncall handoff note: I'll keep monitoring for 30m then hand to @bob_runtime for overnight follow-up. Whoever takes postmortem owns RCA, mitigations, and changelog.
alice_sre: timeline notes for postmortem: detection 18:09, mitigation (traffic split + memory bump) 18:18, kernel flag disable 18:28, 5xx reduced to 6% by 18:32. still capturing cores for analysis.
bob_runtime: adding ticket INF-7432 to track rollback + canary + long-term fix. assigning to eng-runtime.
carol_oncall: final status update for channel: "Mitigations in place — traffic routed to fallbacks, memory limits increased, quant-attn optimization disabled on affected pods. 5xx significantly reduced. Engineering investigating root cause; postmortem/updates forthcoming." :white_check_mark:
alice_sre: handing off investigation artifacts to @bob_runtime (logs, cores, reproducer).
carol_oncall: handing off pager to @bob_runtime for follow-up. @devex_jordan please coordinate customer communications.
bob_runtime: ack. I'll keep the rollback ticket moving and run stress canaries overnight. ping me for escalation.
pm_anu: thanks everyone. I'll prepare a short incident blurb for leadership.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE created: INC-7112223334 — Elevated inference 5xx due to runtime kernel regression. Assigned: eng-runtime. Priority: P1 (degraded production impact).
